Label: CPU rack server (Dell PowerEdge R570 class), scaled to 1 kW
Status: variant: not the case's reference server; the reference house keeps the abstract 1 kW server of config/reference-house.json for scored figures
Description: One 'server' = 1 kW of electric load, like the case. Built from the cheapest sourced rack server (Dell R570, Xeon 6507P 8 cores, 32 GB). Its wall power is not measured, so the box count per kW is an estimate from CPU TDP plus memory.
TranscriptionModel: whisper.cpp base (CPU), own laptop measurement scaled per kWh

UnitElectricKw.source: estimate: Xeon 6507P TDP 150 W (data/raw/market/hardware.csv hw-power-intel-xeon-6507p-tdp) + 32 GB x 0.392 W/GB (Cloud Carbon Footprint memory coefficient, docs/research/computing-price.md §2) = 162.5 W; fans, storage and PSU losses missing, TODO(source): measured wall power

UnitPurchasePriceChf.source: data/raw/market/costs.csv cost-server-dell-r570 (accessed 2026-11-20, high; VAT treatment not shown)

HostElectricKw.source: no separate host: the units are complete servers

HostPurchasePriceChf.source: no separate host: the units are complete servers

ServerElectricKw.source: docs/case/challenge.md: rack-server reference (1 kW), used as normalisation

IdleElectricKw.source: derived: 1 kW x 0.71 / 3.46 W per vCPU, idle/max ratio of the Cloud Carbon Footprint SPECpower coefficients (data/raw/market/hardware.csv hw-power-ccf-aws-min-w-per-vcpu and -max-, medium); not measured on this server

HeatRecoveryShare.source: docs/case/challenge.md: 80 percent recoverable into water (assumes liquid cooling; the R570 offer is air-cooled)

PurchasePriceChfPerServer.source: derived: UnitsPerServer x UnitPurchasePriceChf + HostPurchasePriceChf = 6.152 x 8248.03; entry configuration, a denser CPU server is likely cheaper per kW: TODO(source) quote for a ~1 kW CPU server

LifetimeYears.source: data/raw/market/costs.csv lifetime-microsoft-server-accounting (accounting life, not physical life)

OpsChfPerServerYear.source: derived: 6.152 boxes x CHF 59 per server-month x 12 (data/raw/market/costs.csv cost-ops-smartsolution-server-basic, retail managed monitoring + patching per box); fleet-scale cost TODO(source); site internet (cost-ops-green-connect-s) excluded

TranscriptionAudioHoursPerServerHour.source: own measurement, branch feat/T-02-transcription-job docs/jobs/transcription.md: whisper.cpp base, whole-laptop energy 0.0382 Wh per audio minute scaled to 1 kWh (572 with CPU-package meter); assumes a server CPU is as efficient per kWh as the laptop

WebhostingSitesPerServer.source: TODO(source): no sourced webhosting throughput per kW yet (T-23)

SpotPriceChfPerServerHour.source: docs/research/computing-price.md A2: Azure D32as v5 spot Switzerland North (cp-cpu-azure-d32as-v5-chn-spot) x 5.89 instances per kW; range 1.80-3.44

OnDemandPriceChfPerServerHour.source: docs/research/computing-price.md A1: lowest Swiss-region on-demand 32-vCPU VM per kW; range 7.10-11.09
